Insurance

Asignación de capital

The process by which an insurer or group assigns capital resources to business lines, risks, or subsidiaries, optimizing return on equity and regulatory capital requirements.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Asignación de capital?

In this glossary, Asignación de capital refers to: The process by which an insurer or group assigns capital resources to business lines, risks, or subsidiaries, optimizing return on equity and regulatory capital requirements.

How is Asignación de capital used in finance?

In finance communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "La asignación estratégica de capital permite a las aseguradoras optimizar rendimientos y cumplir con estándares de solvencia."

Why does Asignación de capital matter in finance?

Asignación de capital matters because it supports clear communication in Insurance contexts for Financial Analysts, Bankers, and Traders. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as CFA, ACCA, and FRM.

Who uses Asignación de capital?

Asignación de capital is mainly used by Financial Analysts, Bankers, and Traders.

What category does Asignación de capital belong to?

In this glossary, Asignación de capital is grouped under Insurance. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?
